steps: Drain and rinse the cooked chickpeas thoroughly in a colander.
Peel and mince the garlic clove finely.
Halve and deseed the cucumber, then dice into small 0.5 cm cubes.
Add chickpeas, plain Greek yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and cumin to a food processor.
Blend for about 60 seconds until the dip is smooth and creamy.
Transfer the dip to a medium bowl and stir in the diced cucumber and fresh dill.
Cut each pita bread into 6 small triangles suitable for toddler hands.
Serve the dip in the bowl alongside the pita triangles for dipping.
Store leftover dip covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days; keep pita separate.
